amends: phase1b_attempt_source_adjudication_protocol.json step E (the HYBRID rule) and step D scope

certification_per_player_game: API PBP (missed, blocked) == official HTML play-by-play (missed, blocked), exact, for every skater in the frozen table, using the HTML report of the SAME game
for 2022-2023 additionally == official realtime (missedShots, shotAttemptsBlocked), exact
a game whose HTML report has ANY unparseable / unmappable shot-event row is not certifiable: every player-game of that game is INVALID_SOURCE_CONFLICT

ANY exception makes the player-game INVALID_SOURCE_CONFLICT: its attempt data are MISSING (never used, never imputed from the other source); the appearance is excluded from every attempt window exactly like an unobtainable game
decision_rule_v2.scope: official HTML play-by-play for ALL 7,923 source games (the 222 already fetched + the remaining 7,701); full certification, not a sample

source_hierarchy.attempts: shot_attempts_v2 = official SOG + certified missed + certified blocked
source_hierarchy.missed_and_blocked: API PBP own missed / own blocked attempts, used for a player-game ONLY if CERTIFIED
source_hierarchy.sog: official stat line only (frozen stats-REST summary, boxscore-confirmed for every known difference); event-record SOG is NEVER used

status_criteria.HYBRID_ATTEMPT_SOURCE_JUSTIFIED: (a) step A: 113/113 official; (b) after full certification the INVALID_SOURCE_CONFLICT player-games are < 0.5% of all player-games (a sanity ceiling for 'source usable', NOT a tolerance: invalid rows are removed, not accepted); (c) every retained player-game has exact agreement of all available sources; (d) every retained SOG-mismatch player-game keeps official SOG

reasons_from_data: SOG authority: all 113 SOG differences are resolved to the official stat line by the current official boxscore (step A).

for 2022-2023 the official stat reports themselves define individual attempts: totalShotAttempts == shots + missedShots + shotAttemptsBlocked on all 93,099 rows, and on all 35 SOG-mismatch rows official attempts == official SOG + components while the event record is exactly one higher: the hybrid formula IS the official attempt definition.
API PBP missed and blocked equal the official stat reports on all 93,099 player-games of 2022-2023 (0 mismatches), including the single event on which HTML disagrees with the API.
registered: AFTER the protocol-1 adjudication data above was seen and BEFORE any model is fit or scored; Phase 1B-A's performance protocol (features, folds, metrics, gates S1-S7, seed) is NOT amended
transparency: protocol-1 rule E returned ATTEMPT_SOURCE_NOT_TRUSTWORTHY (kept in phase1b_attempt_source_adjudication.json). The rule asked an EVENT record (HTML play-by-play) to 'confirm' an OFFICIAL STAT LINE that the data show to differ from both event records by exactly one credited shot in 0.040% of player-games; that confirmation can never hold and was a design flaw, whereas the decisive official evidence (stat-line reports) was not used by the rule. This amendment replaces it with player-game-level certification, never with a tolerated mismatch rate.
